description: Shows the status of the homeowner's quote requests: pending (waiting for the contractor), quoted (with the quote total, card processing fee, payment schedule and expiry), accepted (with job and escrow status), quote_declined, quote_expired or cancelled. Pass request_id for one request, or omit it to list the most recent ones. Read-only. Requires a linked RateDeed account (scope quotes:read).

limit.description: How many recent requests to list when request_id is omitted.

request_id.description: Request ID from submit_quote_request, e.g. QR-7K2M9QXD4T.

name: get_request_status
title: Check quote requests
